notes: SEQN is the unique participant identifier in NHANES, mapping to person_source_value in the person table.
Food/Individual component number is an ordinal identifier for food items within a dietary recall. Stored as value_as_number with a custom observation_concept_id.
Dietary day one sample weight is a continuous numeric weight variable. Stored as value_as_number in the observation table.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a continuous numeric weight variable. Stored as value_as_number in the observation table.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating the quality/reliability of the recall. Mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer. Stored as value_as_string in the observation table.
Breast-fed infant indicator is a binary variable. Mapped to value_as_concept_id using standard Yes/No concepts (e.g., 4188539 for Yes, 4188540 for No).
Number of days of intake is an ordinal count. Stored as value_as_number in the observation table.
Intake day of the week is a categorical variable. Mapped to value_as_concept_id using standard day-of-week concepts.
Language used mostly is a categorical variable. Mapped to value_as_concept_id using standard language concepts (e.g., 4182343 for English).
Combination food number is an ordinal identifier for combination food entries. Stored as value_as_number.
Combination food type is a categorical/text description. Stored as value_as_string in the observation table.
Time of eating occasion (HH:MM) is a time value. Stored as value_as_string; could also be converted to a time concept if standard concepts exist.
Name of eating occasion (e.g., breakfast, lunch) is a categorical variable. Mapped to value_as_concept_id using standard meal/snack concepts if available.
Source of food (e.g., store, restaurant) is a categorical variable. Mapped to value_as_concept_id using standard food source concepts if available.
Binary variable indicating if meal was eaten at home. Map to OBSERVATION with a custom concept for 'Meal location' and use value_as_concept_id for Yes/No (e.g., 4188539 'Yes', 4188540 'No').
USDA food code is a source identifier, not a standard concept. Store as string in OBSERVATION with observation_concept_id representing 'USDA food code'.
Modification code is categorical. Map to OBSERVATION with a custom concept for 'Food modification code' and value_as_concept_id for specific modifications.
Grams of food consumed. Map to MEASUREMENT with measurement_concept_id for 'Food weight' (e.g., custom concept) and unit_concept_id for gram (8587).
Energy in kcal. Standard concept for 'Energy' (kcal) is 4322388. Unit concept_id for kilocalorie is 8588.
Protein in grams. Standard concept for 'Protein' (mass) is 3025315. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Carbohydrate in grams. Standard concept for 'Carbohydrate' (mass) is 3025315. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Total sugars in grams. No direct standard concept; use custom concept for 'Total sugars' or map to 'Sugar' (concept_id 3025315) with distinction in measurement_concept_id.
Dietary fiber in grams. Standard concept for 'Fiber' (mass) is 3025315. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Total fat in grams. Standard concept for 'Fat' (mass) is 3025315. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Saturated fatty acids in grams. No direct standard concept; use custom concept for 'Saturated fat' or map to 'Fat' (3025315) with distinction in measurement_concept_id.
Monounsaturated fatty acids in grams. No direct standard concept; use custom concept for 'Monounsaturated fat'.
Polyunsaturated fatty acids in grams. No direct standard concept; use custom concept for 'Polyunsaturated fat'.
Cholesterol in mg. Standard concept for 'Cholesterol' (mass) is 3025315. Unit concept_id for milligram is 8576.
Vitamin E as alpha-tocopherol in mg. No direct standard concept; use custom concept for 'Vitamin E' or 'Alpha-tocopherol'. Unit concept_id for milligram is 8576.
Added alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E) intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 40762432 represents Alpha-tocopherol; value_as_number holds the mg amount.
Retinol intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3009542 represents Retinol; value_as_number holds the mcg amount.
Vitamin A, RAE intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 40762434 represents Vitamin A; value_as_number holds the mcg amount.
Alpha-carotene intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 40762435 represents Alpha-carotene; value_as_number holds the mcg amount.
Beta-carotene intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 40762436 represents Beta-carotene; value_as_number holds the mcg amount.

Lycopene intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 40762438 represents Lycopene; value_as_number holds the mcg amount.
Lutein + zeaxanthin intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 40762439 represents Lutein and Zeaxanthin; value_as_number holds the mcg amount.
Thiamin (Vitamin B1) intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3006914 represents Thiamine; value_as_number holds the mg amount.
Riboflavin (Vitamin B2) intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3005456 represents Riboflavin; value_as_number holds the mg amount.

Vitamin B6 intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3006555 represents Vitamin B6; value_as_number holds the mg amount.
Total folate intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004249 represents Folate; value_as_number holds the mcg amount.
Folic acid intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 40762440 represents Folic acid; value_as_number holds the mcg amount.
Food folate intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004249 represents Folate (food folate is a form of folate); value_as_number holds the mcg amount.
Dietary Folate Equivalent (DFE) intake from day 1. Maps to OMOP concept for Folate measurement.
Total choline intake from day 1. Maps to OMOP concept for Choline measurement.
Vitamin B12 intake from day 1. Maps to OMOP concept for Vitamin B12 measurement.

Selenium intake from day 1. Maps to OMOP concept for Selenium measurement.
